title: Level Up!
author: Israel M.
desc: This program is specifically designed to build a very well rounded physique and bring up muscles that are often forgotten but have a large impact on your overall look , like the neck , forearms and calves. The program puts extra emphasis on the shoulders and upper back for a yoked aesthetic.

ex.note: Behind preacher curl
Keep elbow high, focus on pulling with the rear delt
Legs out/ Bar to nipples/ Elbows in and out/ Shoulders back without big arch
Flare elbows
Focus on keeping tension on the hamstrings and spinal erectors
Don't bounce out of the bottom
Retract scapula and clavicles, Pull towards upper traps/bottom of neck
Keep the Scapula depressed, don't lose tension on lats.
Keep the Scapula depressed, don't lose tension on lats.
Squeeze at the top and control the eccentric.
Keep core tight, hands touching, and elbows off pads.
